privacy.ai_training_note: CoCounsel explicitly does not use user content or prompts to train CoCounsel, underlying language models, or third-party AI models (OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini). Third-party partners are contractually prohibited from using customer data for model training. Thomson Reuters processes all GenAI requests under Thomson Reuters identity, never disclosing individual customer identity to LLM providers.
privacy.data_region: Primary: United States (with separate availability zones for backup). Optional region-based hosting: UK, Australia, Canada. All interactions with OpenAI GPT and Google Gemini processed in U.S.
